prompt.task: Use the provided interests and rated questions to create 10 new questions in the format "Truth or Dare".

rules.rule: Questions must be different from the given questions.
Consider the provided interests when generating questions.

Consider the ratings of previous questions. Ratings are from 1 to 5: 1 = do not generate another question on this topic, 2 = generate significantly fewer questions on this topic, 3 = neutral, 4 = generate more questions on this topic, 5 = definitely generate more questions on this topic.
Generate more questions related to highly rated topics and fewer questions related to poorly rated topics.
The output must contain exactly 10 questions: 5 Truth questions and 5 Dare questions.
Leave the rating empty in the output.
